title: Mere ghar maula aaye
body:
aza ka chaand jab dekha
gali gali mein kaale parcham aate hai nazar
hussain hussain hussain hussain
log azadari ko nikle hai shahraon par
hussain hussain hussain hussain
falak se kiski sawari aayi alam saje ghar ghar
hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bicha hai farsh majlis ka
mere ghar maula aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
banayi sheh nasheen ghar mein
nishan e gham sajaya hai
siyaah parde lagaye hai
zamane ko bataya hai
samjh leta ke ye dunya
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere ghar aaj majlis hai
zameen waalon falak waalon
agr shauq e ziyarat hai
sheh e deen ke azadaron
ziyarat ko chale aana
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maah e aza hai kaale parcham lao
ghar pe jari ka alam lehrao
guzre jahan se juloos aza ka
raahon mau us ke sabeelein lagao
baanto tabarruk nazr dilao
bachon ko apne saqqa banao
ghar ghar mein farsh aza ka bichao
karo elaan majlis ka
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
moharram jab nahi hota
to ye manzar nahi hota
bapa majlis jo hoti hai
ye ghar wo ghar nahi rehta
bana hai ghar aza khana
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dehleez par dekho
khataarein ambiya ki hai
atayein kis khadar mujh par
sakina ke chacha ki hai
alam dekha to dil bola
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot tha shauq is dil mein
mai dekhun rauza maula ka
khabar thi mere maula ko
karam mujh par hua aisa
ke ek din khawab mein dekha
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar o deewar mehke hai
aqeedat ye bataati hai
kisi hasti ki aamad hai
khabar khushboo sunati hai
jisay tu ghar bulaata tha
sawari us ki aati hai
ujaala ho gaya har soo
giray phir aankh se aansu
raha na qalb na qaabu
lagay ek khwaab ke jaisa
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bulaya maine maula ko
to wo tanha nahi aaye
kisi ko laaye maqtal se
kisi ko shaam se laaye
aur un ke saath hai zehra
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab hai kaifiyat dil ki
khushi hai aur hai gham bhi
karun mai shukr ke sajde
musalle par hai matam bhi
dhala hai shukr mein nauha
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha farhan ne ro kar
likhi kya baat mazhar ne
ajal ka jab payaam aaya
to mai bola farishte se
abhi mai aa nahi sakta
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya sayyed e mazloom lutay ghar ka lo pursa
naizon par shaheedon ke har ek sar ka lo pursa
ali akbar ka lo pursa ghazi ka lo pursa
ali asghar ka lo pursa
haan aun o mohamed ka lo qasim ka lo pursa
kulsoom ka zainab ka sakina ka lo pursa
qaimon ka lo pursa luti chaadar ka lo pursa
bemaar ka pursa jalay bistar ka lo pursa
haye mere maula ye bare ghar ka lo pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
ya mazloom hussaina
hussain hussain hussaina
pyase hussaina
hussain hussain hussaina
ghar tera loota gaya
hussain hussain hussaina
kunba bhi pyasa raha
hussain hussain hussaina
har ek qaima jhal gaya
hussain hussain hussaina
chin gayi sab ki rida
hussain hussain hussaina
rote hai ahle aza
hussain hussain hussaina
matam ki goonje sada
hussain hussain hussaina
ghar ghar hai farsh e aza
hussain hussain hussaina
author: Mazhar Abidi
